description:
**Features**
- Custom model and textures
- Custom animations
- Changed VFX
- New SFX & VO
- An infinite supply Gamorrean guards to munch on



Bringing back one of my old mods, thanks to the ease of use of Divine's modding tools!

This is an up-to-date version of Rancor Cho'Gath. 

### **Disclaimer!**
This is, by all means, still a very old mod of mine. It's jank and it's pretty ugly. So don't expect anything special! But people asked me for it so here it is.
